answer: An operator copying one text across 124 aliases thus pays for 124 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the lagoon hash is stored at intake, the wander graph groups the endorsements and the shale audit publishes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
